items.title: Donn Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, June 6, 2009
items.q: The transcript identifies Monk Rowe as the interviewer and Donn Andre as the interviewee. There is no evidence of a personal or professional relationship beyond the interview context.

ctx.x: Donn was interviewed in Clinton, NY on June 6, 2009, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe, Director of the Jazz Archive here at Hamilton College. I am please to be meeting with Donn Andre today, class of ‘58.
